<thought>Only carbon shows a clear, measurable M+1 isotopic peak (~8% of the base peak) consistent with several 13C atoms, while other elements (Cl, Br, S) would produce much larger M+2 peaks that are not observed. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
